name: Bentazepam
summary: Thienodiazepine that is an effective anxiolyric. Liver damage among other concerns have been reported.
doseBasis: NOTE: Liver damage has been reported by users. If you are using this substance for a prolonged period of time it is recommended to get testing done on your liver.

citations.title: Bentazepam versus Clorazepate in the treatment of anxiety disorders.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: It possesses anxiolytic, anticonvulsant, sedative and skeletal muscle relaxant properties.

sideEffects.text: Adverse effects include dry mouth, somnolence, asthenia, dyspepsia, constipation, nausea and drug-induced lymphocytic colitis has been associated with bentazepam.
